verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no alerting or notification feature for Workers. Built-in observability is mentioned only generically. Event subscriptions to Queues and Agents SDK chat/email connectors are developer building blocks for constructing custom alerts, not a configurable alerting capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can set up alerts that notify me via chat or email when specific conditions are met
